description: Append a dated bullet under '## Decisions' in a project's AGENTS.md (auto-loaded memory). Call this PROACTIVELY right after a non-obvious or architectural decision is made — don't wait to be asked — then tell the user in one line what you recorded. For concise, durable decisions and WHY; not bugs (use log_issue) and not trivia.

text.description: One line: the decision and WHY, not just what.

name: append_decision
title: Append a decision
